title: CmdPal: Port UI tests to UITestAutomation.Next (winappcli)

confidence.rationale: The same current source defines MatchesMainWindow with case-insensitive Contains; only misleading documentation is changed.

proposed_comments.body:
**Severity: Low (non-blocking documentation).**

`MatchesMainWindow` uses case-insensitive `Contains` for the expected process and title. Calling this a strict title match misstates the actual disambiguation contract; the following process-only fallback is what this branch takes precedence over. Keep the existing predicate and its tests unchanged.

```suggestion
                            // Case-insensitive title substring match wins over process-only fallback for sibling
```

The original and literal suggested complete files both parse successfully and have identical executable tokens. This corrects the comment only; it is not evidence of a wrong-window failure or an end-to-end UI test pass.
proposed_comments.title: Describe the actual title-matching contract
